name: You Get One Ride
hint: Three takes, in one forced order. Two ONE_SHOT rails run their path exactly ONCE — the instant their switch first fires — and then they are dead for the rest of the take, so a ride you are not already standing on is a ride you have lost. mA (deck x=19.6..23.8, top y=19.4) lifts 7.8 units to y=11.6 at 3.0 u/s, armed by switch s1 at x=3..4. mB (deck x=34..38, top y=10.8) lifts 7.0 units to y=3.8 at 2.0 u/s, armed by switch s2 at x=6..7. Both switches are down on the floor and both rails climb straight up, so no jump substitutes for either: the mid ledge at y=11.0 is 9 units above the floor and the exit ledge at y=4.0 is 7 units above the mid ledge. TAKE 1: walk right to about x=3.2, stand in reach of s1, wait, and press interact ONCE at about t=4.0s. mA rises empty; stay where you are and let the take run out. TAKE 2: Echo A now fires s1 at t=4.0s. Walk right to about x=6.2, in reach of s2, wait, and press interact ONCE at t=10.0s. mB rises empty. TAKE 3: run right from spawn — 17.8 units, about 1.9s — to x=18.8 where mA's deck face stops you, and hop the 0.6 up onto the parked deck by about t=2.3s. You are aboard when Echo A fires s1 at t=4.0s; ride to y=11.6, arriving t=6.6s, then jump right from x=23.0 over the 1.0 gap and 0.6 up onto the mid ledge (x=24.8..33). Run right 6.9 units to x=32.2 and jump the 1.0 gap onto mB's parked deck — 0.2 up — aboard by about t=8.2s. Echo B fires s2 at t=10.0s and you ride 7.0 units up, arriving y=3.8 at t=13.5s. Jump LEFT from x=34.0 over the 1.0 gap onto the exit ledge (top y=4.0, a 0.2 drop) and walk left into the exit at x=29.5, about t=14.2s. Press each switch once only — a second press toggles it back off. Do not try to arm your own ride: from s1 you need 1.9s to reach the boarding point, by which time mA's deck is already 5.9 units above the floor and no jump reaches it.

dialogue.text: One run each. The rail forgets how to go back.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: So the hand on the switch can never be the body on the platform.
